questions.stem: A 19-Year-old woman with amenorrhea presents with pain abdomen, vomiting, and bleeding pv. She has no comorbidities. She had her last cycle ten weeks ago. On examination, P-90/min, BP -110/70mmHg, afebrile, saturation normal, RR-12/min, pallor present, dehydration present. Abdominal examination shows tenderness. PV examination shows bleed and products of conception. UPT is positive, hCG is found to increase, and using shows snowstorm appearance. The true statements about this condition are all except?

options.label: A
options.text: Molar chromosomes are derived entirely from the father

options.label: B
options.text: Higher the ratio of paternal: to maternal, the more significant the molar change

options.label: C
